subject: Security walkthrough coordination and fallback windows (SOC 2 / pen test / DPA)
body:
From: Rajiv Desai <rajiv@finhelm.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@finhelm.com, Amelia Hart <amelia.hart@finhelm.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood walkthrough — proposed windows + required attendees

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick follow-up. Legal and our InfoSec lead both asked for a single consolidated walkthrough covering: SOC 2 evidentiary map, proposed pen-test scope, and the DPA redlines summary.

Can you do any of the following windows next week (all in IST / converted below):
- Tue 17 Aug 09:00–10:15 IST (US-east friendly late evening)
- Wed 18 Aug 02:00–03:30 IST (early APAC slot)
- Thu 19 Aug 20:00–21:30 IST (US-west overlap)

We need the Redwood engineering lead (service auth / logs) and someone who can speak to the DPA retention settings. Also will attach our baseline questionnaire.

Thanks,
Rajiv

--
Rajiv Desai
Security Program Manager, Finhelm Financial
rajiv@finhelm.com

-----------------------------

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Desai <rajiv@finhelm.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — proposed windows + required attendees

Hi Rajiv — appreciate the details. We can cover SOC 2 evidence mapping, pen-test scope, and DPA redline highlights in a single session; I agree having Legal and InfoSec on the call is helpful.

Quick note on internal attendees:
- I will moderate and handle the DPA questions.
- Karthik (cc'd) can cover our infra/serving runtime and log retention options.
- Olga (cc'd) is our Trust & Compliance engineer and will run through the SOC 2 mapping and evidence pointers.

I have three possible blocks that map to the windows you shared. Please confirm which you prefer; I will tentatively hold them on my calendar and loop in the engineers as soon as you confirm:
- Tue 17 Aug 09:00–10:30 IST (Tue 16 Aug 23:30–01:00 PDT) — 90min
- Wed 18 Aug 02:00–03:30 IST (Tue 17 Aug 16:30–18:00 PDT) — 90min
- Thu 19 Aug 20:00–21:30 IST (Thu 19 Aug 07:30–09:00 PDT) — 90min

Attachments: I attached a short deck that summarizes what we'll walk through and a checklist so you can confirm attendees.

If Legal needs to see a DPA digest ahead of the call, I can share a doc; otherwise we can walk through it live.

Best,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: Redwood_walkthrough_deck.pdf (pdf), walkthrough_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

-----------------------------

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, Rajiv Desai <rajiv@finhelm.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 05:40:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — proposed windows + required attendees

Adding my quick availability note — all three windows work for me except Thu 19 Aug evening is tight because of an internal release dry run. My preference would be Wed 18 Aug (the early APAC slot) so we can have the full engineering team on and not be in the middle of a release.

If Wed is ok, I can prepare a short section on log export paths, request routing fallbacks, and our KV cache retention settings which Legal often asks about. Will also bring the suggested pen-test scoping constraints (non-destructive, timeboxed, IP allowlist).

Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

-----------------------------

From: Rajiv Desai <rajiv@finhelm.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@finhelm.com, Amelia Hart <amelia.hart@finhelm.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 09:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — proposed windows + required attendees

Soojin/Karthik/Olga — thanks for the fast turnaround. Legal has requested one change: they want our Head of Legal (Amelia) to review DPA redlines first and then either attend or join for the last 20 minutes. That means the earlier Wed slot will work best for us (gives time to prep).

Please confirm Wed 18 Aug at 02:00 IST (we'll plan for 90min but expect the last 20 minutes may be DPA-focused with Amelia). Also please share the DPA digest ahead of time so our Legal can pre-read.

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Regards,
Rajiv

--
Rajiv Desai
Security Program Manager, Finhelm Financial
